fixtures.policy: Exact Fraction masses/products; Decimal100 natural logarithms. Binary64 absolute/relative budget 2e-12*max(1,abs(expected)): up to six log terms, scaled across at most 1200 repetitions; no bound is used for exact fractions or signed infinity. Direct products intentionally expose underflow and are not repaired.

Exact normalized Fraction source masses, Decimal100 log-difference terms and independent CE−H total. Binary64 budget 2e-12*max(1,abs(expected)); six logarithmic terms with bounded source normalization. Individual KL terms may be negative; small residuals are rounding, not a counterexample to the analytic inequality. Exact equality and infinity require exact policy matches.

Independent Decimal400 raw exp sum and log(total), with analytic equal/dominant enormous cases. Exact binary64 inputs via Decimal.from_float. Log/denominator budget 2e-12*max(1,abs(expected)); probability absolute budget 2e-14 (underflow rounds to zero or subnormal). Normalization budget 32*epsilon*6=4.2633e-14 for at most six nonnegative terms. NaN/+Infinity/empty rejected; all −Infinity undefined; isolated −Infinity excludes a class. Finite-logit range overflow is numerical, not excluded support. Masked mean denominator is the number of contributing positions.
